---
title: "Directional Signaling 3D Mapping"
output: html_document
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(Seurat)
library(dplyr)
library(readxl)
library(jsonlite)

base_dir <- "/home/mattia/Thesis/111125ST_def"

# Output directories
out_sc <- file.path(base_dir, "figures", "3D_signaling_modules")
out_sp <- file.path(base_dir, "figures", "3D_spatial_signaling_modules")
dir.create(out_sc, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
dir.create(out_sp, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

# --- ADJUSTABLE PARAMETERS ---
# Threshold for top X% most active regions (e.g. 0.90 = Top 10%)
overlap_threshold <- 0.90

# Spatial pseudotime distance to consider as "overlapping" or paracrine gap
# (e.g. 3 units means a Ligand and Receptor within 3 units of each other are considered overlapping)
overlap_tolerance_pt <- 3.0
# ----------------------------
```

## 1. Load Single-Cell Data & Mesh

```{r load_data}
cat("Loading Single Cell object...\n")
sc_obj <- readRDS(file.path(base_dir, "Random data", "sc_with_spatial_scores.rds"))

cat("Loading 3D Mesh...\n")
mesh_data <- readRDS(file.path(base_dir, "figures", "3D_mesh_plots_starvation", "tube_mesh_cache.rds"))

cat("Loading Signaling Components...\n")
sig_data <- read_excel(file.path(base_dir, "Excels", "list_of_signalling_components.xlsx"))
```

## 2. Process Genes (Single-Cell)

```{r process_genes}
# Filter for ligands and receptors (case insensitive)
sig_data <- sig_data %>%
  filter(toupper(Group) %in% c("LIGAND", "RECEPTOR"))

# Format gene names to match Seurat
sig_data$Formatted_Gene <- gsub("[[:space:]]", "", toupper(gsub("\\..*$", "", sig_data$Symbol)))

# Check presence in Seurat
available_genes <- rownames(sc_obj)
sig_data$In_Seurat <- sig_data$Formatted_Gene %in% available_genes

cat("\nSummary of valid genes mapped to SC Seurat:\n")
print(table(sig_data$In_Seurat))
```

## 3. Add Module Scores (Single-Cell)

```{r add_scores}
pathways <- unique(sig_data$Pathway)
roles <- unique(toupper(sig_data$Group))
module_names <- c()

for (p in pathways) {
  for (r in roles) {
    genes <- sig_data %>% filter(Pathway == p & toupper(Group) == r & In_Seurat == TRUE) %>% pull(Formatted_Gene)
    if (length(genes) > 0) {
      safe_p <- gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9]", "_", p)
      module_name <- paste0(safe_p, "_", r)
      sc_obj <- AddModuleScore(sc_obj, features = list(genes), name = module_name)
      actual_col <- paste0(module_name, "1")
      sc_obj[[module_name]] <- sc_obj[[actual_col]]
      sc_obj[[actual_col]] <- NULL
      module_names <- c(module_names, module_name)
    }
  }
}
```

## 4. Single-Cell: Map to Mesh and Export

```{r export_continuous}
# Extract coordinates from mesh
x <- mesh_data$v_matrix[, 1]
y <- mesh_data$v_matrix[, 2]
z <- mesh_data$v_matrix[, 3]
i <- mesh_data$f_matrix[, 1]
j <- mesh_data$f_matrix[, 2]
k <- mesh_data$f_matrix[, 3]
v_pt <- mesh_data$vertex_pseudotime

sc_valid <- subset(sc_obj, subset = !is.na(Smoothed_Pseudotime))
cell_pt <- sc_valid$Smoothed_Pseudotime

for (mod in module_names) {
  expr <- sc_valid[[mod]][,1]
  loess_model <- loess(expr ~ cell_pt, span = 0.3)
  predicted_expr <- predict(loess_model, v_pt)
  
  valid_expr <- predicted_expr[!is.na(predicted_expr)]
  if(length(valid_expr) > 0) {
    q_low <- quantile(valid_expr, 0.05, na.rm=TRUE)
    q_high <- quantile(valid_expr, 0.95, na.rm=TRUE)
    predicted_expr[predicted_expr < q_low] <- q_low
    predicted_expr[predicted_expr > q_high] <- q_high
  }
  
  trace <- list(
    type = 'mesh3d',
    x = x, y = y, z = z, i = i, j = j, k = k,
    intensity = predicted_expr,
    colorscale = 'Viridis', opacity = 1.0, showscale = TRUE,
    colorbar = list(title = "Score", tickformat = ".4f", exponentformat = "none")
  )
  trace_json <- toJSON(list(trace), auto_unbox = TRUE)
  title_text <- paste("SC Directional Signaling:", mod)
  
  html_template <- paste0('<!DOCTYPE html><html><head><title>', title_text, '</title><script src="https://cdn.plot.ly/plotly-2.27.0.min.js"></script></head><body style="margin: 0; padding: 0;"><div id="plotly-div" style="width:100vw; height:100vh;"></div><script>var data = ', trace_json, '; var layout = {title: "', title_text, '", scene: { aspectmode: "data" }}; Plotly.newPlot("plotly-div", data, layout);</script></body></html>')
  
  out_path <- file.path(out_sc, paste0(mod, "_3D.html"))
  writeLines(html_template, out_path)
}
```

## 5. Single-Cell: Composite Overlap Plots

```{r export_composite}
base_pathways <- unique(gsub("_LIGAND$|_RECEPTOR$", "", module_names))
for (bp in base_pathways) {
  lig_mod <- paste0(bp, "_LIGAND")
  rec_mod <- paste0(bp, "_RECEPTOR")
  
  if (lig_mod %in% module_names && rec_mod %in% module_names) {
    lig_expr <- sc_valid[[lig_mod]][,1]
    lig_loess <- loess(lig_expr ~ cell_pt, span = 0.3)
    pred_lig <- predict(lig_loess, v_pt)
    
    rec_expr <- sc_valid[[rec_mod]][,1]
    rec_loess <- loess(rec_expr ~ cell_pt, span = 0.3)
    pred_rec <- predict(rec_loess, v_pt)
    
    lig_thresh <- quantile(pred_lig, overlap_threshold, na.rm=TRUE)
    rec_thresh <- quantile(pred_rec, overlap_threshold, na.rm=TRUE)
    
    is_lig_raw <- !is.na(pred_lig) & pred_lig >= lig_thresh
    is_rec_raw <- !is.na(pred_rec) & pred_rec >= rec_thresh
    
    # Expand active zones by tolerance distance
    is_lig_exp <- rep(FALSE, length(v_pt))
    for (p_val in v_pt[is_lig_raw]) { is_lig_exp[abs(v_pt - p_val) <= overlap_tolerance_pt] <- TRUE }
    
    is_rec_exp <- rep(FALSE, length(v_pt))
    for (p_val in v_pt[is_rec_raw]) { is_rec_exp[abs(v_pt - p_val) <= overlap_tolerance_pt] <- TRUE }
    
    category <- rep(0, length(v_pt))
    category[is_lig_raw] <- 1
    category[is_rec_raw] <- 2
    
    # Bridge gaps and overlaps with Purple
    category[is_lig_exp & is_rec_exp] <- 3
    
    trace <- list(
      type = 'mesh3d',
      x = x, y = y, z = z, i = i, j = j, k = k,
      intensity = category,
      colorscale = list(
        c(0, "#E2E2E2"), c(0.2, "#E2E2E2"),
        c(0.2, "#E41A1C"), c(0.5, "#E41A1C"),
        c(0.5, "#377EB8"), c(0.8, "#377EB8"),
        c(0.8, "#984EA3"), c(1.0, "#984EA3")
      ),
      cmin = 0, cmax = 3, opacity = 1.0, showscale = FALSE 
    )
    
    trace_json <- toJSON(list(trace), auto_unbox = TRUE)
    title_text <- paste0("SC Composite Overlap: ", bp, "<br><span style='font-size:14px; color:#666;'>(Top ", (1-overlap_threshold)*100, "%, Tolerance ", overlap_tolerance_pt, " pt) | </span><span style='font-size:14px; color:#E2E2E2; background:#333; padding:2px;'>Grey: Neither</span> <span style='font-size:14px; color:#E41A1C;'>Red: Ligand</span> <span style='font-size:14px; color:#377EB8;'>Blue: Receptor</span> <span style='font-size:14px; color:#984EA3;'>Purple: Both/Close</span>")
    
    html_template <- paste0('<!DOCTYPE html><html><head><title>', title_text, '</title><script src="https://cdn.plot.ly/plotly-2.27.0.min.js"></script></head><body style="margin: 0; padding: 0;"><div id="plotly-div" style="width:100vw; height:100vh;"></div><script>var data = ', trace_json, '; var layout = {title: "', title_text, '", scene: { aspectmode: "data" }}; Plotly.newPlot("plotly-div", data, layout);</script></body></html>')
    
    out_path <- file.path(out_sc, paste0(bp, "_Composite_Overlap_3D.html"))
    writeLines(html_template, out_path)
  }
}
```

## 6. Spatial Transcriptomics Pipeline

```{r spatial_pipeline}
cat("\n--- Running Spatial Data Pipeline ---\n")
sp_obj <- readRDS(file.path(base_dir, "Random data", "merged_guts_spatial.rds"))

# Format gene names to match Spatial (standard casing, just remove spaces)
sig_data$Spatial_Gene <- gsub("[[:space:]]", "", gsub("\\..*$", "", sig_data$Symbol))
available_sp_genes <- rownames(sp_obj)
sig_data$In_Spatial <- sig_data$Spatial_Gene %in% available_sp_genes

cat("Summary of valid genes mapped to Spatial Seurat:\n")
print(table(sig_data$In_Spatial))

sp_module_names <- c()
for (p in pathways) {
  for (r in roles) {
    genes <- sig_data %>% filter(Pathway == p & toupper(Group) == r & In_Spatial == TRUE) %>% pull(Spatial_Gene)
    if (length(genes) > 0) {
      safe_p <- gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9]", "_", p)
      module_name <- paste0(safe_p, "_", r)
      sp_obj <- AddModuleScore(sp_obj, features = list(genes), name = module_name)
      actual_col <- paste0(module_name, "1")
      sp_obj[[module_name]] <- sp_obj[[actual_col]]
      sp_obj[[actual_col]] <- NULL
      sp_module_names <- c(sp_module_names, module_name)
    }
  }
}

# Map to Mesh
sp_valid <- subset(sp_obj, subset = !is.na(Spatial_Pseudotime))
cell_pt_sp <- sp_valid$Spatial_Pseudotime

for (mod in sp_module_names) {
  expr <- sp_valid[[mod]][,1]
  loess_model <- loess(expr ~ cell_pt_sp, span = 0.3)
  predicted_expr <- predict(loess_model, v_pt)
  
  valid_expr <- predicted_expr[!is.na(predicted_expr)]
  if(length(valid_expr) > 0) {
    q_low <- quantile(valid_expr, 0.05, na.rm=TRUE)
    q_high <- quantile(valid_expr, 0.95, na.rm=TRUE)
    predicted_expr[predicted_expr < q_low] <- q_low
    predicted_expr[predicted_expr > q_high] <- q_high
  }
  
  trace <- list(
    type = 'mesh3d', x = x, y = y, z = z, i = i, j = j, k = k,
    intensity = predicted_expr, colorscale = 'Viridis', opacity = 1.0, showscale = TRUE,
    colorbar = list(title = "Score", tickformat = ".4f", exponentformat = "none")
  )
  trace_json <- toJSON(list(trace), auto_unbox = TRUE)
  title_text <- paste("Spatial Directional Signaling:", mod)
  
  html_template <- paste0('<!DOCTYPE html><html><head><title>', title_text, '</title><script src="https://cdn.plot.ly/plotly-2.27.0.min.js"></script></head><body style="margin: 0; padding: 0;"><div id="plotly-div" style="width:100vw; height:100vh;"></div><script>var data = ', trace_json, '; var layout = {title: "', title_text, '", scene: { aspectmode: "data" }}; Plotly.newPlot("plotly-div", data, layout);</script></body></html>')
  
  out_path <- file.path(out_sp, paste0(mod, "_Spatial_3D.html"))
  writeLines(html_template, out_path)
}

# Composite Overlap for Spatial
base_pathways_sp <- unique(gsub("_LIGAND$|_RECEPTOR$", "", sp_module_names))
for (bp in base_pathways_sp) {
  lig_mod <- paste0(bp, "_LIGAND")
  rec_mod <- paste0(bp, "_RECEPTOR")
  
  if (lig_mod %in% sp_module_names && rec_mod %in% sp_module_names) {
    lig_expr <- sp_valid[[lig_mod]][,1]
    lig_loess <- loess(lig_expr ~ cell_pt_sp, span = 0.3)
    pred_lig <- predict(lig_loess, v_pt)
    
    rec_expr <- sp_valid[[rec_mod]][,1]
    rec_loess <- loess(rec_expr ~ cell_pt_sp, span = 0.3)
    pred_rec <- predict(rec_loess, v_pt)
    
    lig_thresh <- quantile(pred_lig, overlap_threshold, na.rm=TRUE)
    rec_thresh <- quantile(pred_rec, overlap_threshold, na.rm=TRUE)
    
    is_lig_raw <- !is.na(pred_lig) & pred_lig >= lig_thresh
    is_rec_raw <- !is.na(pred_rec) & pred_rec >= rec_thresh
    
    is_lig_exp <- rep(FALSE, length(v_pt))
    for (p_val in v_pt[is_lig_raw]) { is_lig_exp[abs(v_pt - p_val) <= overlap_tolerance_pt] <- TRUE }
    is_rec_exp <- rep(FALSE, length(v_pt))
    for (p_val in v_pt[is_rec_raw]) { is_rec_exp[abs(v_pt - p_val) <= overlap_tolerance_pt] <- TRUE }
    
    category <- rep(0, length(v_pt))
    category[is_lig_raw] <- 1
    category[is_rec_raw] <- 2
    category[is_lig_exp & is_rec_exp] <- 3
    
    trace <- list(
      type = 'mesh3d', x = x, y = y, z = z, i = i, j = j, k = k,
      intensity = category,
      colorscale = list(
        c(0, "#E2E2E2"), c(0.2, "#E2E2E2"),
        c(0.2, "#E41A1C"), c(0.5, "#E41A1C"),
        c(0.5, "#377EB8"), c(0.8, "#377EB8"),
        c(0.8, "#984EA3"), c(1.0, "#984EA3")
      ),
      cmin = 0, cmax = 3, opacity = 1.0, showscale = FALSE 
    )
    
    trace_json <- toJSON(list(trace), auto_unbox = TRUE)
    title_text <- paste0("Spatial Composite Overlap: ", bp, "<br><span style='font-size:14px; color:#666;'>(Top ", (1-overlap_threshold)*100, "%, Tolerance ", overlap_tolerance_pt, " pt) | </span><span style='font-size:14px; color:#E2E2E2; background:#333; padding:2px;'>Grey: Neither</span> <span style='font-size:14px; color:#E41A1C;'>Red: Ligand</span> <span style='font-size:14px; color:#377EB8;'>Blue: Receptor</span> <span style='font-size:14px; color:#984EA3;'>Purple: Both/Close</span>")
    
    html_template <- paste0('<!DOCTYPE html><html><head><title>', title_text, '</title><script src="https://cdn.plot.ly/plotly-2.27.0.min.js"></script></head><body style="margin: 0; padding: 0;"><div id="plotly-div" style="width:100vw; height:100vh;"></div><script>var data = ', trace_json, '; var layout = {title: "', title_text, '", scene: { aspectmode: "data" }}; Plotly.newPlot("plotly-div", data, layout);</script></body></html>')
    
    out_path <- file.path(out_sp, paste0(bp, "_Spatial_Composite_Overlap_3D.html"))
    writeLines(html_template, out_path)
  }
}

cat("\nPipeline Completed. Check both output folders!\n")
```
